name: Eikoku Shinshi no Tenazukekata
source:
This story is set in early 19th-century England. 

The protagonist, Florence, is a young woman of the middle class on the cusp of her social debut. She receives an invitation to a ball hosted by a close friend—the daughter of a Viscount.

There, she encounters the haughty noble Earl, Sir Gwyn=Hartford, and they quickly end up in an argument... but what happens next?

A short-form otome visual novel for ladies who dream of winning the heart of a true English gentleman!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10459]Novelgame[/url]]
